name: Collapsible
description:
The Collapsible component is used to expand and collapse additional content. It allows you to show or hide content with a trigger, and is useful for accordions, dropdowns, and expandable sections.

It supports an initial open state, a partial collapsed height to preview the content, and different open/close effects on the content.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Collapsible component.

props.name: effect
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for effect.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the collapsible. Useful for composition.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the collapsible.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial open state of the collapsible when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the open state of the collapsible.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The callback invoked when the open state changes.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: The callback invoked when the exit animation completes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the collapsible is disabled.

props.name: collapsedHeight
props.description: The height of the content when collapsed.

props.name: collapsedWidth
props.description: The width of the content when collapsed.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

props.name: hideMode
props.description: How to hide content when mounted but not present. - `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive. - `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
